deliveryMetric: Required original evidence actually present in the stored DB and included with provenance in the delivered body; missing locations alone do not count as original body delivery.
retention: Keep a DB/cache only while another planned call needs it. Delete completed study DBs and caches after extracting results; retain logs, metrics and digests without compression or archives.
scope: A new empty-DB seed, followed by topics 1, 2, 3 and the same three topics in a second lap; every topic starts in a new chat and saves its new history.
tokenMetric: input_tokens + output_tokens; cached input counted once, all failed consumption included; seed acquisition cost separate
